title: Fuel Charging and Controls — 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS)
introduction:
This page points you to the operating explanation and component descriptions for the fuel charging and controls system on the engine identified in the title. I keep that engine identity beside the reference: a familiar-looking engine cover is a lousy substitute for the right chapter.

Choose the system-operation referral when you want to understand the coordinated system, or the component-description referral when you want to understand individual parts. Both direct you to the same manual section. This is a navigation reference, with no component inventory, operating sequence or diagnostic test reproduced here.

edits.text: To read how the fuel charging and controls system operates, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The operating explanation provides the system-level context for understanding the parts that work together.

edits.text: To read descriptions of the fuel charging and controls components, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The component descriptions connect individual part names with their functions within the system.
